liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (2 reviews): Jerry's vocal is chilling, especially the 'only love can fill' lines; Reviewer especially enjoys this song [11][13]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Playin' is singled out as huge [15]
- **Me And Bobby McGee** (1 review): Jerry and Bob share strong harmony vocals on this song [9]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The NFA>GTRFB>NFA sequence is called huge [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big RR Blues**: rare: 8 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd71-10-30.prefm.nawrocki.26608.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4.45/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Keith's piano is bright and forward in the mix; a source cut is audible in GDTRFB; This pre-FM master sounds better than the reviewer's third-generation analog tape copies from years ago; Sounds clean and clear, with harmonic vocals throughout, like a soundboard source [9][10][11][12]
- **gd71-10-30.fm.cole.2664.sbeok.shnf**: FM broadcast; 22 songs; 159 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Mix is poor: Jerry's guitar sits very low, mics seem to bleed into the board, and levels peak [7]
- **gd1971-10-30.137408.fm.GEMS.flac16**: FM broadcast; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1971-10-30.sbd.130823.MrBill.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 134 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Describes Taft Auditorium as a beautiful theater in downtown Cincinnati [8]
- Keith Godchaux had joined the band in public less than two weeks earlier; rehearsal is evident in the playing [9]
- There is friendly stage banter, and Phil introduces Keith to the crowd [11]
- Pigpen's absence is felt, but there is plenty of back-and-forth with the crowd [15]
- Calls it the bar band Dead with new keyboardist Keith, rating him the band's best keyboard player [12]
- Presents it as a rock-a-billy era Dead show and a unique moment in the band's history [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-10-30.prefm.nawrocki.26608.sbeok.shnf**: source: primary: Pre-FM MR (1/2 track, 7.5 ips), Transfer: Revox PR99-MKIII > Panasonic SV3800 (48)/Sony 60ES > M-Audio Audiophile USB > CDWave > Goldwave (resample to… [1]. Also: Primary source was supplied by Josh [1]
- **gd71-10-30.fm.cole.2664.sbeok.shnf**: source: FM> Pioneer RT-707 (7" reel @ 19 ips)> CD [2]
- **gd1971-10-30.137408.fm.GEMS.flac16**: taped by Stuccoholmes; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Recording of the FM Broadcast on WEBN Cincinnati, DAT provided and transferred by Stuccoholmes, Editing and Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1, Critical… [3]
- **gd1971-10-30.sbd.130823.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Updated Recording Info: Pre FM SBD > MR > RR @ 7 1/2 IPS; Transfer Info: RR > 1978 Teac 3440 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Transfered, tracked and… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Alton Kelley: [Grateful Dead NRPS Taft Theater Cincinnati OH 1971 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/213209/Grateful-Dead-NRPS-Taft-Theater-Cincinnati-OH-1971-Concert-Poster) [18]
- Poster by www.gratefulseconds.com: [Dead Too "Gloomy" Near Halloween: Taft Auditorium, October 30, 1971 FM Broadcast](http://www.gratefulseconds.com/2016/09/dead-too-gloomy-near-halloween-taft.html) [19]
- Poster by diskunion.net: [TAFT AUDITORIUM, CINCINNATI, OCTOBER 30, 1971 WEBN BROADCAST (3CD) / TAFT AUDITORIUM, CINCINNATI, OCTOBER 30, 1971 WEBN ](https://diskunion.net/rock/ct/detail/1008600296) [20]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1971-10-30 Sat Taft Auditorium, Cincinnati, OH](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1422476877076/grateful-dead-1971-10-30-sat-taft) [21]
- Poster by jpc.de: [Grateful Dead: Taft Auditorium Cincinnati, Ohio, Oct. 30 1971 (3 CDs)](https://www.jpc.de/jpcng/poprock/detail/-/art/grateful-dead-taft-auditorium-cincinnati/hnum/4153231) [22]
